title: The Counter Sale customer's tier fields in Edit Customer
stem: How should "Every walk-in sale uses this tier." show?

options.t: As a tooltip on the tier fields, as the PRD says
As a light blue info box above the tier fields, always visible, as the design draws

context: The PRD says Edit Customer shows a tooltip on the Counter Sale customer's tier fields. The design shows the same sentence in a box that is always visible.
